svg.title: Train driver — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as train driver, wearing a work uniform and a service cap. Visible work cue: A tapered locomotive front has a windscreen and central lamp above clearly diverging railway tracks. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
